The conversation concerns temporary luggage storage arrangements in Krakow. [p1] inquired about leaving several suitcases, noting the location lacks a dedicated closet space and that items would need to be placed in a corner of a room.
[me] provided specific instructions for stacking and placing the bags: one large suitcase, one large bag (which can be stacked on top of the first), and a large shopping-style bag (like an ATB grocery bag) which could also be placed on top.
decisions: Luggage will be stored in the corner of the room.
